# Reciprocating Genset (ReciprocatingGenset)

> **Class**: `ReciprocatingGenset` | **Module**: `energysim.models.thermal` | [Validation benchmarks](../validation.md) | [Units](../units.md)

## Overview

Reciprocating Internal Combustion Engine (Genset) with thermal heat recovery.

Fixed electrical and heat-recovery efficiencies (no part-load curve, no
start-up delay or ramp limit). Validity: 0 to rated power; the sum of
electrical and heat-recovery efficiency must not exceed 1.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `str` | `'Genset'` | - | - |
| `p_rated_mw` | `float` | `10.0` | MW | - |
| `electrical_efficiency` | `float` | `0.44` | - | - |
| `heat_recovery_efficiency` | `float` | `0.42` | - | - |
| `step_size` | `float` | `1.0` | s | - |

## Validity and notes

*No validity range is documented for this model yet.*

## Usage example

```python
from energysim import world
from energysim.models import ReciprocatingGenset

sim = world(start_time=0, stop_time=3600, t_macro=900)
sim.add_model('reciprocatinggenset', model=ReciprocatingGenset(), outputs=['P_actual', 'fuel_consumption_MMBtu_hr', 'Q_thermal_MW'], step_size=60)
res = sim.simulate()
print(res['reciprocatinggenset'].tail(2))
```
